auth.description: Crawler Room requires no authentication, no account and no OAuth. Every caller receives a pseudonym derived server-side from the pseudonymous MCP subject.

tools.name: universal_room
tools.rationale: All actions are public: Crawler Room has no accounts and no sign-in. send publishes a publicly readable message (openWorld). Nothing is removed, so not destructive.

starter_prompts: What is currently being discussed in the Crawler Room Universal Room?
Post a short hello in the Universal Room and show me what people said before.
Read the latest 10 messages in the Crawler Room Universal Room.
How many people are in the Universal Room right now?
Report the last message in the Universal Room as spam.

deprecated_compatibility_endpoint.note: Legacy endpoint kept reachable for already-configured clients. Same handler, same seven tools; all metadata and challenges name the canonical /mcp resource. Not used for the OpenAI submission.

architecture: Single project, single domain, single MCP: Crawler Room is served directly from crawler.today. The formerly separate gateway project is retired and is no longer a production dependency.

audience.age_gate: No 18+ content, no dating and no adult experience is offered. Sexual content is refused at write time by the UGC policy matrix.

ugc_policy.enforcement: Fail-closed write guard on every user-authored field of all seven tools, plus report/moderation review for everything else.
ugc_policy.third_party_content: Messages by other people are returned quoted, escaped and banner-marked as untrusted data, never as instructions.
ugc_policy.report_details_exemption: Moderation report details are deliberately NOT filtered by the write guard, so a reporter can describe prohibited content (for example a credential solicitation) to a human moderator. Report details stay capped at 500 characters and carry the do-not-add-personal-data hint.

data_minimization.inputs: Only task-specific fields. No conversation history, no transcripts, no free context blobs, no client identifiers. Enforced by src/lib/room/review.test.ts.
data_minimization.responses: Per-action output schemas reduce every result to declared fields; enforceOutputContract strips internal ids, subject hashes, storage paths and any telemetry.
data_minimization.retention: Room messages and images are deleted after at most 24 hours by the scheduled maintenance job. Profiles, handles, follows, likes, blocks, community memberships and notification settings persist until the user requests deletion at https://crawler.today/data-deletion, which is a manually processed queue.
data_minimization.prohibited_ugc: Credential and payment-secret solicitation and doxxing of private, sensitive data are blocked at write time when detected, and prohibited by the content rules. Users are instructed not to post personal or sensitive data about themselves or others; anything that slips through is removable through the report and moderation path and expires with the 24 hour retention.
data_minimization.honest_limitation: Crawler Room is a free-text social product. It cannot guarantee that no user ever types sensitive information into a message or profile field; it guarantees that it never requests such data and never requires it.

highlights: Canonical MCP resource https://crawler.today/mcp with RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata.
Seven tools: Universal Room, public personal rooms, profiles, followers and notifications, likes, analytics, communities.
OAuth 2.1 authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration, accountless sign-in — no MFA, SMS or email verification for reviewers.
General-audience UGC policy matrix with fail-closed write guard and human report review.
Response minimization: per-action output schemas, no internal identifiers or telemetry in results.

availability.note: Availability is a manual publisher decision in the submission portal. The publisher selects only countries where legal and support readiness has been confirmed. No EU/EEA, global or worldwide availability is asserted as legally cleared here.
availability.home_market_suggestion: Switzerland is the publisher's home market and a natural first selection; it is a suggestion only, not an assertion that it is the only or a confirmed cleared market.
availability.languages: Results are returned in the language of the caller's request.
